claim_reviews.rationale: The deployed evidence pull and UAT exception worklist directly support a stitched assurance flow, while their incompatible volume units remain separate.
The customer-confirmed CIO record explicitly prioritizes privileged-access evidence completeness and human-owned certification decisions.
The boundary runs from campaign opening through a human certification decision, and customer-confirmed campaign and entitlement keys coherently join the two automations.
The declared not_needed decision is supported because the pilot compiles fields and applies deterministic evidence checks while assurance reviewers retain every routing and certification judgment.
Maestro, Robots, and human review are plausible orchestration roles, but entitlement, deployment, connectivity, and product availability remain unconfirmed.
Evidence completeness and traceability are credible directional levers, but 26,400 entitlement lines and 1,200 exceptions are nonadditive and no validated value baseline or funded case exists.

The proposed 120-case historical shadow has confirmed identifiers, an accountable truth-set owner, measurable gates, and human review. Execution still requires data access, approved baselines and tolerances, product and deployment validation, and pilot authorization.
The portfolio separates customer-confirmed priorities, identifiers, ownership, and conditional sample availability from proposed UiPath roles and unapproved execution.
The live mailbox intake and UAT purchase-order exception worklist directly support the stated invoice-exception opportunity, with their distinct volumes kept separate.
The customer-confirmed strategy record explicitly prioritizes Finance throughput while preserving human control over exceptions and payments.
The mapped boundary connects mailbox intake to Finance disposition and payment-review handoff, with customer-confirmed invoice identifiers joining the frozen records.
The declared not_needed decision is supported because structured invoice evidence and approved exception rules can be tested deterministically while Finance retains every disposition.
Maestro, Robots, and human review are plausible orchestration roles, but entitlement, deployment, connectivity, and product availability remain unconfirmed.
Reviewer capacity, consistency, and auditability are credible directional levers, but 18,000 submissions and 4,200 exceptions cannot be combined and no validated savings or funded case exists.

The proposed 100-case historical shadow has a confirmed join key, accountable truth-set owner, measurable gates, and human review. Execution still requires data access, approved baselines and tolerances, product and deployment validation, and pilot authorization.
The portfolio separates customer-confirmed Finance priorities, linkage, ownership, and conditional sample availability from proposed UiPath roles and unapproved execution.
The production supplier intake and approved-backlog risk review directly support one onboarding evidence-readiness opportunity while preserving their distinct workload measures.
The customer-confirmed strategy record explicitly prioritizes supplier onboarding evidence and risk-review controls.
The mapped boundary connects supplier intake to the Supplier Risk Lead's review outcome, with a customer-confirmed request identifier joining the frozen records.
The declared not_needed decision is supported for the first pilot because the approved taxonomy can be tested with deterministic rules before considering adaptive support.
Maestro, Robots, and human review are plausible orchestration roles, but entitlement, deployment, connectivity, and product availability remain unconfirmed.
Evidence completeness, consistency, and reduced rework are credible directional levers, but 1,400 intake requests and 900 reviews may overlap and no validated savings or funded case exists.

The proposed 80-file redacted historical shadow has a confirmed join key, approved taxonomy owner, measurable gates, and human review. Execution still requires data-access and redaction approval, approved baselines and tolerances, product and deployment validation, and pilot authorization.
The portfolio separates customer-confirmed supplier priorities, linkage, ownership, taxonomy, and conditional sample availability from proposed UiPath roles and unapproved execution.
